analysis.analysis: The market is exhibiting classic pre-correction signals with vol regime shifting from pinned to tension, indicating building pressure beneath seemingly calm surface conditions. The model disagreement between short-term bullish signals (7d/14d) and longer-term bearish outlook (21d champion model) suggests we're in a transition phase where momentum hasn't yet caught up to underlying structural weakness. The CAG reading of 0.60 (BEAR-DELUDED) indicates retail/institutional positioning remains overly optimistic despite deteriorating fundamentals. Positive GEX provides temporary downside support but won't hold if selling pressure accelerates.
analysis.regime_assessment: Transitional tension regime - building volatility pressure with conflicting timeframe signals indicating potential regime change ahead
analysis.model_trust: Trust the 21d champion model over shorter timeframes - tension regimes favor longer-term models as they capture structural shifts better than momentum-based shorter signals
analysis.risk: Portfolio exposed to gap-down risk if tension regime breaks to downside - positive GEX support may fail quickly in selling cascade
analysis.action_detail: Implement defensive hedges via VIX calls or SPY puts, reduce high-beta exposure, and prepare for potential regime break lower given champion model bearish signal
